CCTV4: Premiere of Chinese Etiquette & Ceremonies: Understanding China Through the Lens of Li
- By CCTV4
- Updated
0
As featured on
BEIJING, Nov. 19, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- What lies at the heart of the Chinese spirit? China Media Group's flagship cultural program for 2025, Chinese Etiquette & Ceremonies, seeks to answer this question in a single word: Li — the traditional concept of etiquette and ritual propriety.
